glosses: pop (music intended for or accepted by a wide audience)

examples.text: Ela gosta de música pop russa.

examples.en: I'd like to listen to pop music.

examples.text: Tom é demasiado velho para singrar como cantor pop.
examples.en: Tom is too old to make it as a pop singer.

examples.text: Antigas estrelas pop são simplesmente mulheres velhas quando completam 40 anos.
examples.en: Former pop stars are just plain old women by the time they're 40.
